transcript.user: My landlord is not returning my security deposit of Rs 40,000 after I vacated the flat. What section of law can I use?
transcript.assistant:
I am sorry to hear about the trouble you are facing with your security deposit. 

However, I can only help with consumer problems (such as defective products, poor services, or online shopping issues). Landlord-tenant disputes and rental deposit issues fall outside consumer law and my scope.

Because of this, I am unable to provide legal sections or specific advice for rental disputes. I recommend consulting a local lawyer who handles property/rental matters, or reaching out to your District Legal Services Authority (DLSA) for advice or free legal aid if you are eligible [KB:LEGAL-AID].

Please note that this is general information, not a lawyer's advice.
